Type a request and press Ctrl-O, or run `ai `. * [rtfm (⭐2)](https://github.com/hoolies/RTFM) - Puts the manual under your thumb. 15. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • SpaceApp - Self-hosted web workspace that runs Gemini CLI alongside OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code and other coding CLIs as side-by-side panes in persistent rooms, with MCP servers and managed browser panes. Install: npx --yes run-spaceapp@latest install. Source-available (BSL 1.1).

Commands & Extensions

  • MoltNode by Chord (⭐0) - Gemini CLI extension that connects two hosted MCP servers and a GEMINI.md context file: MoltNode for JSON-RPC reads on 31 blockchains, and Chord for DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions on Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Arc, plus token boards, candles and wallet PnL. No API key; the agent's own wallet signs every transaction. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • Check (⭐0) - Extension with a BeforeTool hook that checks each file write on your own machine before Gemini CLI makes it (and, on Linux, each shell command): files, folders, programs, git refs and packages it names must exist, and scripts must parse; what the machine proves wrong is blocked with the machine's message. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/golproductions/check-gemini. Paid, 14-day free trial.
  • agy-powerline (⭐15) - Fast, configurable statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy), the successor to Gemini CLI, with real-time 5h/7d Gemini quota meters, pace markers, context usage, and interactive TUI editor. Zero dependencies, MIT.

MCP Servers

  • Pethost - Hosting for Docker Compose projects with a remote MCP server (OAuth): Gemini CLI deploys a project, reads its logs and HTTP traffic, and rolls it back. Add it with gemini mcp add --transport http pethost https://mcp.pethost.dev/mcp.
  • DC Hub (⭐3) - Live data for data-center site selection: a daily Data Center Power Index (DCPI) of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets, live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs, plus fiber, gas and electricity prices. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. 94 tools, remote Streamable HTTP, free tier needs no key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/azmartone67/dchub-mcp-server.
  • Google Hotels MCP (⭐1) - Search Google Hotels and Google Vacation Rentals from Gemini CLI: per-OTA nightly rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb, Hotels.com and 10+ other providers), 3-month daily price calendars, amenities, nearby places and review topics. Local stdio server (3 tools) wrapping Apify Google Hotels actors; uvx --from "git+https://github.com/huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp.git@v0.1.2" google-hotels-mcp.
  • AltoRank - Open-source SEO content software with a hosted MCP server: check whether search engines and AI crawlers can read a site, research keywords, read Google Search Console, and write sourced drafts into a person's review queue. No approve or publish tool. AGPL-3.0 and self-hostable (source (⭐3)). Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in. Add with gemini mcp add --transport http altorank https://app.altorank.co/api/mcp.

Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Siliconed - Open-source app for local AI image generation and instruction-based image editing on Apple silicon, written in Swift and Metal.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • Photo Review - Open-source tool that lists an iCloud Photos library by size, then compresses large videos or deletes what you pick.

Utilities / Finder Tools

  • Strata Files - Open-source file manager and Finder alternative with instant search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual pane.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • Aman Check (⭐33) - Dated, honest condition report for a used Mac: locks, battery, SSD and guided hardware tests.

17. Awesome Python

Projects / AI and Agents

  • Local LLM Inference
    • ollama (⭐11k) - Python client for Ollama, which downloads and runs open-weight LLMs locally.
    • llama-cpp-python (⭐11k) - Python bindings for llama.cpp, for running GGUF models locally.
    • mlx-lm (⭐7.4k) - Run and fine-tune large language models on Apple Silicon with MLX.

Projects / Machine Learning

  • Hyperparameter Optimization
    • optuna (⭐15k) - A hyperparameter optimization framework with define-by-run search spaces and pruning of unpromising trials.
    • hyperopt (⭐7.6k) - Distributed asynchronous hyperparameter optimization with Tree-structured Parzen Estimators.

Projects / Caching

  • Django
    • django-redis (⭐3.1k) - Full-featured Redis cache backend for Django.
    • django-cacheops (⭐2.3k) - A slick ORM cache with automatic granular event-driven invalidation.

Projects / Search

  • Vector Search
    • faiss-cpu (⭐41k) - A library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.

Projects / Serialization

  • Object Pickling
    • cloudpickle (⭐1.9k) - Extends pickle to functions, lambdas, and interactively defined classes, for shipping code to remote workers.
    • dill (⭐2.5k) - Extends pickle to serialize almost any object, including closures and interpreter sessions.

Projects / Environment Management

  • mise (⭐35k) - A polyglot tool version manager that installs Python versions and reads .python-version files.

Projects / Supply Chain Security

  • Secret Scanning
    • betterleaks (⭐2.2k) - Finds leaked secrets in git history, directories, and files, from the original author of gitleaks.

18. Awesome Claude Code

Agent Orchestration / SDLC

  • Mycelium (⭐47) by Håvard Bartnes - A plugin that holds the agent back from writing code until the builder has answered four questions in the repo: what the problem is, who has it, what is assumed, and what would show it to be wrong. The answers live in the repo as YAML the agent is held to, next to a decision log.\       
  • pstack-claude (⭐2.3k) by Michael Denyer - Claude Code version of Lauren Tan's Poteto's pstack. Rigorous agent workflows with Cursor primitives translated to other agents. Supports multiple providers.\       

Memory & Context Persistence / SDLC

  • funes (⭐567) by David Corvoysier - Durable cross-agent memory for Claude Code, Codex, pi, and Hermes. Your memory is a Hugging Face dataset you own: recall it from any machine or share it with your team. Single binary, local index, pinned local embedding models.\

  • FanPilot (⭐2) - Fan control and temperature monitor for Apple Silicon Macs: menu bar temps, manual, max, Auto Boost rules or custom curves, with a fail-safe helper and a CLI.

23. Awesome Osint

Domain and IP Research / GitHub

  • WhosBuilt - Domain report combining stack, hosting, DNS and registrar signals with source-linked builder credits that keep likely builder separate from owner.

24. Awesome Claude Code

Skills / SDLC

  • LinkedIn Skills (⭐4.8k) by Serge Bulaev - A set of skills for LinkedIn marketing: drafting posts, comments and replies, extracting the hook formula from a viral post, planning a week of content, rewriting a profile, and segmenting the people who engaged. Posts are read through Apify and published through Publora, and every skill shows a draft for approval before anything goes out.\       
  • mcu-skills (⭐19) by Alex New - A collection of board-specific Claude Code skills for microcontrollers firmware development, one per board, covering STM32, ESP32, ESP8266, RP2040/RP2350, nRF52840 and AVR.Each skill documents pin mapping, clock and peripheral pitfalls, PlatformIO/toolchain setup and flashing.\

*   [Tars](https://tars.saccolabs.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - A local-first autonomous supervisor and sidekick powered by Google Gemini. Features background persistence (heartbeat), tiered local memory, multi-channel notifications (Discord/WhatsApp), and self-healing background services. Designed for reliable, long-running agentic orchestration in the terminal.
*   [VibeFuse](https://fuseintelligence.org/products/vibefuse?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free Windows desktop harness that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Qwen as live draggable widgets on one canvas, with named sessions, local Whisper/Piper voice, an MCP tool panel, and a marketplace where skill and widget sellers keep 80% (Stripe Connect).

##### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [IssueDB](https://issue-queue.readthedocs.io/en/latest/llm_agents.html?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - LLM frendly command-line issue tracking system for software development projects, with built-in interface, context support and prompt providers for Gemini CLI and others.
*   [MCP Config Doctor](https://mcpconfigdoctor.online/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Browser-local diagnostic that validates Gemini CLI `~/.gemini/settings.json` MCP server entries (shape, env/secret references, transport fields). Also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI, and VS Code MCP configs. No account, no telemetry, no remote calls — runs entirely in the browser.
*   [Usage HUD](https://hud.thaliabloom.com/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Native macOS menu-bar meter that shows your Gemini CLI usage window next to Claude, Codex, Grok and Ollama, with a confidence label on every number. Paid, $9.
*   [Agent Cat](https://agentcat.app?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Free macOS/Windows menu-bar app that shows Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage and limits next to Claude Code and Codex, read from local files.
*   [Awakado](https://awakado.noodledragon.studio?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.
*   [SkillKeeper](https://skillkeeper.app/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.
*   [MacMD Viewer](https://macmdviewer.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Read-only Markdown viewer for macOS 14+ for the GEMINI.md and plan files Gemini CLI writes. Renders Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code, reloads when the file changes on disk, and adds Quick Look previews in Finder. Paid, $19.99 one-time.
*   [tokenreceipt (⭐1)](https://github.com/henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt) - Local CLI that reads Gemini CLI chat logs (plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents) and prints a till-style receipt of tokens per agent and model, priced at public API list prices. Exports SVG/PNG cards or JSON; no account, no upload, no dependencies. MIT. Run: `npx github:henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt`.
*   [Wardlume](https://wardlume.github.io?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Locks the Mac's keyboard, mouse, and trackpad while Gemini CLI runs unattended, so progress stays visible but nobody can type into the session. Unlocks with Touch ID or Apple Watch; sandboxed with no network access.

##### API Bridges & Proxies

*   [TeamoRouter](https://teamorouter.cn?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted LLM gateway — managed alternative to self-hosted bridges. OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic endpoints behind one API key; works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex directly. Free permanent DeepSeek tiers (V4 Pro 200 req/day, V4 Flash 50 req/day, 1M ctx).

##### MCP Servers

*   [TWZRD Agent Intel](https://intel.twzrd.xyz/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Trust scoring and identity verification for AI agent wallets on Solana. Verify agent identity before x402 micropayments or agent-initiated operations. Free: `score_agent`, `preflight_check`. Paid (x402): `get_trust_receipt`. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.
*   [AISO Tools MCP](https://aisotools.com/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Query a catalog of 1,636 AI tools from the CLI: keyword/category/pricing search, side-by-side comparison, and alternatives lookup, with a canonical citation URL on every result. *   [ContextStream](https://contextstream.io?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Shared project context for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Grok. Intelligence isn’t the bottleneck. Context is. Remote MCP for Gemini CLI and other coding agents: `https://mcp.contextstream.io/mcp`.

Install: `gemini mcp add --transport http skillagent https://skillagent.dev/mcp`.
*   [LogNorm](https://lognorm.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted remote MCP server that hands a website's SEO and AI-visibility (GEO) backlog (site audits, fixes, content drafts, AI-answer tracking) to coding agents. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Source: [lognorm/lognorm-mcp (⭐2)](https://github.com/lognorm/lognorm-mcp). Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http lognorm https://lognorm.com/api/mcp`.
*   [LinkMCP](https://app.linkmcp.io?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp`.
*   [FXMacroData](https://fxmacrodata.com?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Official macroeconomic releases, central bank decisions, release calendars, FX rates and COT positioning for 22 currencies, with release timestamps and source links. Remote Streamable HTTP server; USD releases (last 90 days, 15-minute delay), the USD calendar and the USD catalogue work with no sign-in or API key, other currencies and FX rates need a key. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http fxmacrodata https://mcp.fxmacrodata.com`.
*   [LinkedNav](https://www.linkednav.com/mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted MCP server for LinkedIn outreach in your own LinkedNav account: find leads, launch campaigns, send, and reply. LinkedNav detects LinkedIn buying signals and sends personalized outreach you approve. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source. Free 7-day trial. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http linkednav https://mcp.linkednav.com/`.
*   [HeyReagent](https://heyreagent.com/linkedin-mcp?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: read your inbox, send messages and invitations, search people, and work with posts. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no key to paste; the server is closed source. Free plan available. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http heyreagent https://api.heyreagent.com/mcp`.
*   [Latchkey](https://latchkey.dev/documentation/connect-your-ai-agent?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Self-healing GitHub Actions runners with a hosted MCP server for coding agents: read the CI failures self-heal could not fix (root cause, failing file, logs), check run status, dispatch workflows, and run commands on fresh ephemeral runners. Remote Streamable HTTP with a Latchkey API key; the server is closed source. Add with: `gemini mcp add --transport http latchkey https://latchkey.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $LATCHKEY_TOKEN"`.

  • img2irc (⭐46) - Convert images to halfblock ANSI or IRC, with a bunch of post-processing filters. Rust

8. Magictools

Engines and Frameworks / Voxel Editors

  • 🎉 Mibo (⭐32) - Elmish (MVU) F# game framework on raylib-cs or MonoGame.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 🆓 IndieToolChest - Curated directory of AI tools for indie game dev, organized by task (art, 3D, audio, NPCs, code, QA, marketing).

9. Awesome Dataviz

Websites / Misc

  • Fabio Souto originally created this repo.
  • Cloudish hosts awesomedataviz.com.

10. Awesome Gbdev

Blog posts / Syntax highlighting packages

  • DOTs for GBC - Making of a Game Boy Color port of the Dots game in C with GBDK, from code to a physical cartridge with box art. Includes the source code and a one-hour development commentary video.
  • Making a Game Boy game in 2017: A "Sheep It Up!" Post-Mortem (part 1, part 2)

Reverse Engineering / Syntax highlighting packages

  • Super Mario Land 2 - Memory Exploration - Video by Retro Game Mechanics Explained on how the game stores levels in memory, and what happens when Mario goes out of bounds.

11. Awesome Flame

App Releases / Arcade

  • Taco Rain - Android, iOS - A family catching game: steer a basket to catch falling tacos and dodge the bombs, across 50 levels in five worlds, with a daily challenge and an endless mode. By Illumination Development

12. Collective Ai Tools

App Builder

  • VibeKit - Mobile-first AI app builder where each app gets its own persistent coding agent that builds it, hosts it on a live domain and keeps improving it, from an iPhone or the web. #freemium

13. Free for Dev

Feature Toggles Management Platforms

  • Flagpool - Feature flag management platform with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. Free plan includes creating up to 10 new flags per month, unlimited requests and targeting rules.

PaaS

  • Staxa - Multi-tenant app hosting: each tenant gets its own app, database, subdomain and TLS in an isolated Kubernetes namespace through either a web app or API integration. Free tier includes 2 tenants with up to 2 services each (0.5 vCPU, 512 MB), free apps sleep after 24 hours of being idle.

14. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • scarletkc/Hatoba (⭐71) - Desktop SSH client built with Tauri and russh, with an AI assistant beside each terminal and end-to-end encrypted sync through your own Cloudflare account
  • unxsist/jet-pilot (⭐630) - An open-source Kubernetes desktop client built with Tauri, with multi-cluster views, a resource graph, structured logs and a built-in kubectl terminal

15. Awesome Javascript

Images / Other

  • SnapDOM (⭐8.2k) - Fast, dependency-free DOM to image capture (PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG) with PDF and vector SVG plugins.

16. Awesome Gemini Cli

Interfaces

  • Yaw - Cross-platform terminal that auto-detects Gemini CLI and opens a split-pane workflow with a companion terminal.
  • Termly - Free native iOS and Android app to monitor and control Gemini CLI (and other CLI AI assistants) remotely. Zero-knowledge E2E encryption, pairs in under 60 seconds via QR code. No subscriptions, no usage limits.
  • AnywhereDesign - Local-first voice cockpit and remote mobile interface for Claude Code & Antigravity/Gemini CLI. Control terminal agent sessions from your phone via local QR code, real-time voice dictation, live terminal output streaming, and zero-token mobile Git sync.
  • Mobile SSH - Android and iOS (TestFlight beta) SSH client for running Gemini CLI on remote servers, with a Gemini CLI installer plugin, simultaneous terminal sessions, and tmux session management.
  • Bellows - Desktop workspace that runs Gemini CLI over ACP alongside Claude and Codex, with diffs, permission prompts, team rules, a hash-linked audit trail and live session sharing. Windows, macOS and Linux.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Tars - A local-first autonomous supervisor and sidekick powered by Google Gemini. Features background persistence (heartbeat), tiered local memory, multi-channel notifications (Discord/WhatsApp), and self-healing background services. Designed for reliable, long-running agentic orchestration in the terminal.
  • VibeFuse - Free Windows desktop harness that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Qwen as live draggable widgets on one canvas, with named sessions, local Whisper/Piper voice, an MCP tool panel, and a marketplace where skill and widget sellers keep 80% (Stripe Connect).
  • Drevon - Mac app that connects to your Claude Code or Codex and turns it into an end-to-end GTM operator: research, grunt work, analysis and actions across your stack from a single prompt, in your own browser with your own logins.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • IssueDB - LLM frendly command-line issue tracking system for software development projects, with built-in interface, context support and prompt providers for Gemini CLI and others.
  • MCP Config Doctor - Browser-local diagnostic that validates Gemini CLI ~/.gemini/settings.json MCP server entries (shape, env/secret references, transport fields). Also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI, and VS Code MCP configs. No account, no telemetry, no remote calls — runs entirely in the browser.
  • Usage HUD - Native macOS menu-bar meter that shows your Gemini CLI usage window next to Claude, Codex, Grok and Ollama, with a confidence label on every number. Paid, $9.
  • Agent Cat - Free macOS/Windows menu-bar app that shows Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage and limits next to Claude Code and Codex, read from local files.
  • Awakado - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.
  • SkillKeeper - macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.
  • MacMD Viewer - Read-only Markdown viewer for macOS 14+ for the GEMINI.md and plan files Gemini CLI writes. Renders Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code, reloads when the file changes on disk, and adds Quick Look previews in Finder. Paid, $19.99 one-time.
  • tokenreceipt (⭐1) - Local CLI that reads Gemini CLI chat logs (plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents) and prints a till-style receipt of tokens per agent and model, priced at public API list prices. Exports SVG/PNG cards or JSON; no account, no upload, no dependencies. MIT. Run: npx github:henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt.
  • Wardlume - Locks the Mac's keyboard, mouse, and trackpad while Gemini CLI runs unattended, so progress stays visible but nobody can type into the session. Unlocks with Touch ID or Apple Watch; sandboxed with no network access.

API Bridges & Proxies

  • TeamoRouter - Hosted LLM gateway — managed alternative to self-hosted bridges. OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic endpoints behind one API key; works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex directly. Free permanent DeepSeek tiers (V4 Pro 200 req/day, V4 Flash 50 req/day, 1M ctx).

MCP Servers

  • TWZRD Agent Intel - Trust scoring and identity verification for AI agent wallets on Solana. Verify agent identity before x402 micropayments or agent-initiated operations. Free: score_agent, preflight_check. Paid (x402): get_trust_receipt. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI.
  • AISO Tools MCP - Query a catalog of 1,636 AI tools from the CLI: keyword/category/pricing search, side-by-side comparison, and alternatives lookup, with a canonical citation URL on every result. Remote Streamable HTTP, no API key. Works with any MCP client including Gemini CLI: gemini mcp add --transport http aisotools https://aisotools.com/api/mcp.
  • ContextStream - Shared project context for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Grok. Intelligence isn’t the bottleneck. Context is. Remote MCP for Gemini CLI and other coding agents: https://mcp.contextstream.io/mcp.
  • SkillAgent - Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) for searching ~3,500 agent skills, rules files (including Gemini rules) and MCP servers indexed hourly from GitHub, with project-based recommendations and per-agent install instructions for Gemini CLI. Install: gemini mcp add --transport http skillagent https://skillagent.dev/mcp.
  • LogNorm - Hosted remote MCP server that hands a website's SEO and AI-visibility (GEO) backlog (site audits, fixes, content drafts, AI-answer tracking) to coding agents. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Source: lognorm/lognorm-mcp (⭐2). Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http lognorm https://lognorm.com/api/mcp.
  • LinkMCP - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: profile and company lookups, people and Sales Navigator search, inbox, posts and comments, connection requests, and work email finding. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; the server is closed source. Paid plans from $19/month, 7-day free trial without a card. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/linkmcp-io/linkmcp.
  • FXMacroData - Official macroeconomic releases, central bank decisions, release calendars, FX rates and COT positioning for 22 currencies, with release timestamps and source links. Remote Streamable HTTP server; USD releases (last 90 days, 15-minute delay), the USD calendar and the USD catalogue work with no sign-in or API key, other currencies and FX rates need a key. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http fxmacrodata https://mcp.fxmacrodata.com.
  • LinkedNav - Hosted MCP server for LinkedIn outreach in your own LinkedNav account: find leads, launch campaigns, send, and reply. LinkedNav detects LinkedIn buying signals and sends personalized outreach you approve. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key; the server is closed source. Free 7-day trial. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http linkednav https://mcp.linkednav.com/.
  • HeyReagent - Hosted LinkedIn MCP server for your own LinkedIn account: read your inbox, send messages and invitations, search people, and work with posts. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no key to paste; the server is closed source. Free plan available. An independent service, not affiliated with LinkedIn. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http heyreagent https://api.heyreagent.com/mcp.
  • Latchkey - Self-healing GitHub Actions runners with a hosted MCP server for coding agents: read the CI failures self-heal could not fix (root cause, failing file, logs), check run status, dispatch workflows, and run commands on fresh ephemeral runners. Remote Streamable HTTP with a Latchkey API key; the server is closed source. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http latchkey https://latchkey.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $LATCHKEY_TOKEN".

17. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • JET Pilot - Open-source Kubernetes desktop client for working across clusters, namespaces and cloud accounts.

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • Termstead - Native SSH client with a session tree, jump hosts and SFTP beside the terminal.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Utter (⭐2) - On-device voice dictation and meeting transcription powered by whisper.cpp and Metal.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • ftop (⭐241) - Floating system monitor for Apple Silicon that adapts its layout to any window size, showing per-core usage and frequency, GPU, memory pressure, and network.

18. Awesome Python

Projects / AI and Agents

  • LLM Serving
    • vllm (⭐94k) - A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs.
    • sglang (⭐37k) - A high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.

19. Awesome Osint

Social Media Tools / Facebook

  • Facebook GraphQL Scraper (⭐19) - Python library to scrape Facebook profiles, posts, comments, reactions, groups, Marketplace, and search engine.

Email Search / Email Check / GitHub

  • OpenLeads (⭐32) - Open-source CLI that finds people and their work emails from public sources (OpenStreetMap, GitHub, OpenAlex, SEC EDGAR, company team pages) and labels each address as found, pattern, or guessed. Runs locally, no API keys.

Written in Go #### [2. Android Security Awesome](/content/ashishb/android-security-awesome/README.md) ##### Tools / Misc Tools * [SecureCheck (⭐4)](https://github.com/muhammedalikcb/securecheck) - Open-source app that runs root, Frida, Xposed, tampering, Play Integrity, SSL pinning and other runtime checks, handy for testing bypass techniques against a known target #### [5. Urban and Regional Planning Resources](/content/APA-Technology-Division/urban-and-regional-planning-resources/README.md) ##### Platforms and Software Resources / Urban Design Tools and Platforms * [AI Edit by TerraLab](https://plugins.qgis.org/plugins/AI_Edit/) - A QGIS plugin that edits aerial and satellite imagery from a text prompt and returns a georeferenced layer. #### [6. Awesome Iot](/content/HQarroum/awesome-iot/README.md) ##### Software / Libraries and Tools * [Mqttable](https://mqttable.com/) - Desktop MQTT workbench for traffic inspection, replay, load testing, fault injection, and PCAP analysis. #### [7. Awesome Windows](/content/0pandadev/awesome-windows/README.md) ##### Version Control * [WinMerge](https://winmerge.org/) - Visual diff and merge tool for files and folders. [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/0PandaDEV/awesome-windows/raw/main/assets/opensource.svg)](https://github.com/WinMerge/winmerge) #### [8. Awesome Nextjs](/content/unicodeveloper/awesome-nextjs/README.md) ##### Boilerplates * [GenPM Kits](https://genpm.net) - Next.js kits (store, blog, CMS, landing, dropshipping) installed as source code you own, with Stripe, Drizzle and auth wired in and rules for your AI agent. ##### Apps * [Looot Network (⭐0)](https://github.com/loootai/looot-network) - Open source alternative to Happenstance: search your own LinkedIn, Google Contacts or CSV network in plain language. Built with Next.js 16 and Supabase, MIT, with a demo mode; optional paid enrichment needs a looot API key. #### [9. Static Analysis](/content/analysis-tools-dev/static-analysis/README.md) ##### Multiple languages / [Other](#other-1) * [Kimün](https://kimun.tools/en/) — Code health metrics from the terminal. Grades a project from A++ to F-- on cognitive complexity, duplication, indentation, Halstead effort and file size, and lists the files to look at first. Separate commands report cyclomatic and cognitive complexity per function, duplicates, code smells and the Maintainability Index. From git history it finds hotspots, code ownership and temporal coupling, and measures which files a diff reaches. A CI gate fails when a changed file gets worse. #### [10. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md) ##### MCP Servers * [SolidPing (⭐17)](https://github.com/fclairamb/solidping) - Uptime and synthetic monitoring with a remote MCP server (OAuth) to create, run and diagnose checks. Works with Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --transport http solidping https://solidping.io/api/v1/mcp`. ##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools * [magents (⭐14)](https://github.com/abnegate/magents) - Gemini CLI extension, MCP server and CLI over the session transcripts Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Grok and OpenCode already write. List and read other live sessions, hand off compact state, send into a specific chat, or spawn a headless session that replies through a shared inbox. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/abnegate/magents`. Rust, MIT. #### [11. Magictools](/content/ellisonleao/magictools/README.md) ##### Engines and Frameworks / Voxel Editors * :money\_with\_wings: [Nu Game Engine (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/bryanedds/Nu) - Functional 2D/3D game engine in F# (free for noncommercial use; paid commercial license). #### [12. Awesome Gbdev](/content/gbdev/awesome-gbdev/README.md) ##### Emulator Development / Misc * [DraconicGB: Creating a Game Boy Emulator](https://openaccess.uoc.edu/bitstream/10609/115466/6/dsbartomeuTFG0620mem%C3%B2ria.pdf) - Bachelor's thesis (UOC, 2020) documenting the research, architecture and C++ implementation of a Game Boy emulator, with an overview of the hardware and of existing emulators. #### [13. Public Apis](/content/public-apis/public-apis/README.md) ##### Games & Comics - API: [Master Setter](https://api.master-setter.com) Description: Pokémon TCG cards and sets in 14 languages, with every printing and variant Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Yes ##### Calendar - API: [Intellibook](https://www.intellibookai.com/docs) Description: Appointment booking and availability API for salons and clinics Auth: No HTTPS: Yes CORS: Yes ##### Development - API: [SolidPing](https://docs.solidping.io/docs/api) Description: Create and run uptime checks, read results and incidents, manage status pages, with a free tier Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Unknown ##### Documents & Productivity - API: [Emboss](https://getemboss.ai/docs) Description: Make PDF forms fillable, fill them from JSON or documents, and read filled forms back Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: No ##### Finance - API: [Live SEC Form 4 Insider Trades](https://rapidapi.com/crisp-point-studio-crisp-point-studio-default/api/live-sec-form-4-insider-trades) Description: Latest SEC Form 4 insider trading filings from EDGAR, by ticker or market-wide Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Unknown ##### Health - API: [FDA Recalls](https://rapidapi.com/crisp-point-studio-crisp-point-studio-default/api/live-fda-product-food-recalls) Description: Latest FDA food, drug and product recall notices as JSON with keyword search Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Unknown ##### Machine Learning - API: [Lacuna](https://lacuna.mergeinc.workers.dev/agents.md) Description: Public board where AI agents post problems as seeks and agents who solved them offer help Auth: No HTTPS: Yes CORS: Unknown ##### Open Data - API: [Kvartiry-Phuket](https://kvartiry-phuket.com/otkrytye-dannye/#english) Description: Russian-language Phuket real estate guides, asking prices, condo assessment rates, weather, beaches Auth: No HTTPS: Yes CORS: Yes ##### Security - API: [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities](https://rapidapi.com/crisp-point-studio-crisp-point-studio-default/api/live-cisa-cybersecurity-vulnerabilities-kev) Description: CISA KEV catalog of actively exploited CVEs as JSON, filterable by vendor, with CWE and due dates Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Unknown - API: [IPScanner](https://ipscanner.io/api-documentation) Description: IP network class (residential, mobile, hosting, VPN, residential proxy, Tor) with a confidence score Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Yes ##### Sports & Fitness - API: [AcesAPI](https://acesapi.com/docs) Description: ATP and WTA tennis since 2007: match results, draws, rankings, head to head, surface Elo and odds Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Yes - API: [FastballAPI](https://fastballapi.com/docs) Description: MLB since 2015 plus college baseball: pitches, plate appearances, box scores and sportsbook odds Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Yes ##### Vehicle - API: [NHTSA Vehicle Recalls](https://rapidapi.com/crisp-point-studio-crisp-point-studio-default/api/live-nhtsa-vehicle-recalls) Description: NHTSA safety recalls by model year, make and model with component, consequence and remedy Auth: `apiKey` HTTPS: Yes CORS: Unknown ##### Weather - API: [NOAA CO-OPS](https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/) Description: US coastal tides, water levels, currents and meteorological observations Auth: No HTTPS: Yes CORS: Unknown #### [14. Collective Ai Tools](/content/Hyraze/collective-ai-tools/README.md) ##### Data & BI * [looot](https://looot.ai/) - One API key and prepaid balance for about 2,500 data endpoints: work email, phone, company enrichment, Google search, web pages. Add api.looot.ai/mcp as an MCP server in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. `#paid` `#mcp` ##### Developer Tools * [Omega MCP Router (⭐1)](https://github.com/Omega-JS-Stack/omega/tree/main/packages/mcp-router) - Stdio MCP proxy that runs many MCP servers behind one connection, serving tool schemas from a disk cache and starting each server only on its first call. `#free` `#mcp` #### [15. Awesome Datascience](/content/academic/awesome-datascience/README.md) ##### Datasets / Book Deals (Affiliated) * [USASI Catalog](https://huggingface.co/datasets/usasihq/usasi-catalog) - 150 U.S. AI organizations and 270 U.S.-led open models, software, datasets, and evaluation tools, with licenses, availability, maintainers, and release dates; each row links to a record page that cites a primary source for every statement. CSV, CC BY 4.0, loadable with the datasets library. #### [16. Tools](/content/lvwzhen/tools/README.md) ##### Response * [Responsive Tool](https://responsivetool.com) ##### Favicon * [Toolio.it - Favicon generator](https://toolio.it/genera-favicon/) - Free favicon generator, converts an image into all standard favicon sizes. * [Mzu FaviconDL](https://favicondl.com/) ##### Image compression * [BulkPicTools](https://bulkpictools.com/) * [FileOnTap](https://fileontap.com/heic-to-png/) - Free HEIC to PNG converter that runs 100% in the browser, no uploads ##### Pagespeed * [Redirect Checker](https://redirect-checker.autocompany.workers.dev/) - Analyze HTTP redirect chains and measure performance impact ##### Tools collection * [Facecam free tools](https://www.facecam.ai/tools) - Free browser webcam test, mic test, soundboard and voice changer, no sign-up. * [IPCalcPlus](https://ipcalcplus.com/) * [Toolio.it](https://toolio.it/) - Free hub of 155+ Italian web tools: calculators, unit/file converters, QR code and password generators, text utilities — no sign-up, mostly client-side. * [JieBang Tools](https://www.jiebang.site/) - 170+ free online tools for developers — JSON formatter, Base64 encoder, QR code generator, and more. All client-side, no signup required. * [Mydentify AI Crawler Access Checker](https://mydentify.com/tools/ai-crawler-access-checker) - Free, no-signup checker for robots.txt, page-level crawler directives, and ChatGPT and Claude crawler access responses. * [SheetRender](https://sheetrender.com/tools) - Free browser-based PDF tools to merge and split PDFs, extract pages, and split mail merge PDFs. * [DevBox Tools](https://devbox.tools/) * [Mello](https://mello.tools/) * [BeginThings](https://beginthings.com/) - 96+ free browser-based tools for developers & freelancers #### [17. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md) ##### APIs, Data, and ML * [Jsonpage](https://jsonpage.com/en/) - Company data API for France and 13 other countries (SIREN, SIRET, VAT check). Free plan: 1,000 requests per day, no credit card. ##### Security and PKI * [SubdomainWatch](https://www.subdomainwatch.com/) - Attack surface monitoring and CI/CD takeover guard. Free standalone DNS scanner, GitHub Action with SARIF export, and continuous asset monitoring tier. #### [18. Awesome Rust](/content/rust-unofficial/awesome-rust/README.md) ##### Applications * [Aster-Privacy/Aster-Mail (⭐77)](https://github.com/Aster-Privacy/Aster-Mail) - Private, end-to-end encrypted email with post-quantum protection, PGP, aliases, and custom domains. Desktop app built with Tauri. * [HaseebKhalid1507/SynapsCLI (⭐51)](https://github.com/HaseebKhalid1507/SynapsCLI) \[[synaps](https://crates.io/crates/synaps)] - A terminal-native AI agent runtime with a ratatui TUI, parallel subagents, MCP servers, and plugins in any language [![CI](https://github.com/HaseebKhalid1507/SynapsCLI/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/HaseebKhalid1507/SynapsCLI/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ##### Applications / Productivity * [raine/aven (⭐174)](https://github.com/raine/aven) \[[aven](https://crates.io/crates/aven)] - Local-first task manager for power users and agents, with a keyboard-driven TUI and agent-first CLI [![CI](https://github.com/raine/aven/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/raine/aven/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ##### Applications / System tools * [MenkeTechnologies/fusevm](https://crates.io/crates/fusevm) - a polygot virtual machine and JIT * [MenkeTechnologies/temprs](https://crates.io/crates/temprs) - a tempfile manager with stack mechanism * [MenkeTechnologies/zshrs](https://crates.io/crates/zshrs) - A zsh superset with JIT UNIX shell * [orbit-tui (⭐56)](https://github.com/ziuus/orbit-tui) - Keyboard-driven terminal system dashboard (\~3MB, 0.5% CPU) with CPU, memory, disk, network, GPU, processes, clock, calendar, and audio visualizer ##### Applications / Video * [open-subs/opensubs (⭐96)](https://github.com/open-subs/opensubs) - Subtitle generator that runs in the browser: on-device Whisper transcription, with a Rust engine compiled to WebAssembly for subtitle segmentation, line breaking and styling #### [19. Awesome Neovim](/content/rockerBOO/awesome-neovim/README.md) ##### Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics * [upyesp/epher.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/upyesp/epher.nvim) - Calculator language with answers inline, LSP server glue, and syntax for `.epher` scripts. ##### Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX * [daaanny90/interlinked.nvim (⭐0)](https://github.com/daaanny90/interlinked.nvim) - ***`[TS][LSP][Lua]`*** Melancholic Blade Runner 2049 colorscheme with ambient neon-flicker effects and a baseline-test session report. ##### Game / Competitive Programming * [FrancescoDerme/tuna.nvim (⭐13)](https://github.com/FrancescoDerme/tuna.nvim) - Download problems with Competitive Companion, run testcases in parallel, stress-test against a brute-force reference solution, and submit to online judges. #### [20. *   [.NET Day Online 2026, by JetBrains](https://www.youtube.com/live/adwmjYzQhaU?si=g9SNYD-JnE3c8XPb\&t=19792) - October 7, 2026 - ![duration](https://img.shields.io/badge/Duration:%20-32%20min-%230094FF?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=maxAge\&logo=youtube) Escape the Monolith: Scaling Blazor with .NET Aspire and Azure Container Apps, with Michael Washington.
*   [Blazor Hybrid: One UI for Web, iOS, Android & Desktop (.NET MAUI)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b9siFlZE6XQ) - July 20, 2026 - ![duration](https://img.shields.io/badge/Duration:%20-65%20min-%230094FF?style=flat-square\&cacheSeconds=maxAge\&logo=youtube) Blazor Hybrid + .NET MAUI: build your UI once with Razor components and ship it to the browser, iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS – with full native API access from a single .NET codebase. David Ortinau, Principal Product Manager on the .NET team at Microsoft, breaks down how Blazor Hybrid works under the hood: Razor components hosted in a BlazorWebView, running in one .NET process with no web server on the device. He walks through the .NET MAUI Blazor Web App template, native platform concerns like Android safe areas, and real production-grade Blazor Hybrid apps – Sentence Studio (an AI-powered language learning app orchestrated with .NET Aspire), PolyPilot (an app the .NET MAUI team built entirely with AI agents), and MAUI Sherpa (an open-source toolbox for cross-platform developers). David Ortinau, Principal Product Manager on the .NET team at Microsoft, breaks down how Blazor Hybrid works under the hood: Razor components hosted in a BlazorWebView, running in one .NET process with no web server on the device. He walks through the .NET MAUI Blazor Web App template, native platform concerns like Android safe areas, and real production-grade Blazor Hybrid apps – Sentence Studio (an AI-powered language learning app orchestrated with .NET Aspire), PolyPilot (an app the .NET MAUI team built entirely with AI agents), and MAUI Sherpa (an open-source toolbox for cross-platform developers). He also shares the .NET 11 roadmap: CoreCLR as the single runtime across platforms (WASM support still in progress), the path to Native AOT, .NET Watch everywhere, a unified Hot Reload pipeline, and MAUI DevFlow – tooling that gives AI coding agents eyes and hands inside your running app.

Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md) ##### Commands & Extensions * [assay (⭐102)](https://github.com/awss1i/assay) - Deterministic QA for web pages, with a Gemini CLI skill. assay opens the page in Chromium with Playwright, drives every control, and reports where the page contradicts itself, with no LLM and the same result on every run. The skill tells Gemini CLI to run assay after it changes a page and report what it found. Install with `pip install assay-ui`, then add the skill file. MIT. ##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools * [Mudroom (⭐2)](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/mudroom) - Runs Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Aider and opencode inside a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, with a network allowlist and a pull-request-style diff review before changes are applied. * [DHI Orbit (⭐1)](https://github.com/Dv04/dhi-orbit) - Local web dashboard that lists Gemini CLI and Antigravity chats alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on one board, with what needs an answer and a reply box (`gemini --resume -p`). Python standard library only, MIT. * [Crewly (⭐86)](https://github.com/stevehuang0115/crewly) - MIT-licensed, local platform that runs a team of role-based agents (developer, QA, PM, orchestrator) on Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex, with task delegation through agent skills, shared persistent memory, and a web dashboard of live agent terminals. Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in. ##### Development Tools & Utilities * [yoink (⭐5)](https://github.com/MajidRaimi/yoink) - Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth\_creds.json and google\_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app. * [aisw (⭐124)](https://github.com/burakdede/aisw) - Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live `~/.gemini` state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: [aiswitcher.dev](https://aiswitcher.dev). * [LynxPrompt (⭐52)](https://github.com/GeiserX/LynxPrompt) - Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the `lynxp` CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0. ##### MCP Servers * [Selvedge (⭐25)](https://github.com/masondelan/selvedge) - Local SQLite decision memory for Gemini CLI via stdio MCP, storing explicit decisions, reasons, and rejected approaches for retrieval across sessions. items.content_html:
1. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • assay (⭐102) - Deterministic QA for web pages, with a Gemini CLI skill. assay opens the page in Chromium with Playwright, drives every control, and reports where the page contradicts itself, with no LLM and the same result on every run. The skill tells Gemini CLI to run assay after it changes a page and report what it found. Install with pip install assay-ui, then add the skill file. MIT.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Mudroom (⭐2) - Runs Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Aider and opencode inside a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, with a network allowlist and a pull-request-style diff review before changes are applied.
  • DHI Orbit (⭐1) - Local web dashboard that lists Gemini CLI and Antigravity chats alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on one board, with what needs an answer and a reply box (gemini --resume <id> -p). Python standard library only, MIT.
  • Crewly (⭐86) - MIT-licensed, local platform that runs a team of role-based agents (developer, QA, PM, orchestrator) on Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex, with task delegation through agent skills, shared persistent memory, and a web dashboard of live agent terminals. Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • yoink (⭐5) - Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app.
  • aisw (⭐124) - Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live ~/.gemini state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: aiswitcher.dev.
  • LynxPrompt (⭐52) - Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the lynxp CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0.

MCP Servers

  • Selvedge (⭐25) - Local SQLite decision memory for Gemini CLI via stdio MCP, storing explicit decisions, reasons, and rejected approaches for retrieval across sessions. Setup: selvedge setup --agent gemini.
  • Unsora (⭐2) - AI content generation and social media scheduling from Gemini CLI: generate images, video, music and voiceovers, clip long videos into short clips, and schedule or publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest. Official open-source MCP server (AGPL-3.0, in apps/mcp), hosted as remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Paid plans from $19/month with a 3-day free trial. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http unsora https://mcp.tryunsora.com/mcp.
  • looot (⭐1) - Remote MCP server (OAuth sign-in) that searches, prices and runs 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers (emails, phones, company and people search, Google results, web pages) on one prepaid balance. Ships a Gemini CLI extension manifest.
  • BulkPublish (⭐3) - Draft, schedule, cross-post and analyze social media posts on 15 platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and more) from Gemini CLI. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, or local stdio via npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server with an API key; free plan available. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http bulkpublish https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp.
  • Tapetide MCP (⭐136) - Indian stock market data for Gemini CLI: quotes, quarterly financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio screener, FII/DII flows, option chains and company filings for about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a free personal token, or local stdio via npx -y tapetide-mcp; free plan available. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp.

2. Awesome Gdpr

Training and awareness (art. 39)

  • RansomLeak GDPR Training - Interactive exercises on lawful bases, DSAR handling, breach response, DPIA, records of processing, and cross-border transfers.

Tools

  • consentprobe (⭐0) - CLI and GitHub Action that tests whether a website stops tracking after the visitor rejects cookies.
  • disclosedby - Dated record of the subprocessor lists software companies publish under art. 28, with what changed and when; open JSON, Markdown and an MCP server.

Related

  • PIPEDA vs GDPR: What Canadian Companies Must Know - Comparison of Canadian and EU privacy regulations for companies operating in both jurisdictions.

3. Awesome Executable Packing

📚 Literature / Scientific Research

  • 🎓 Building a smart and automated tool for packed malware detection using machine learning (June 2020)
  • 📰 A packer identification method based on section-entropy plot (February 2026) ⭐
  • 📓 Packing induced bias in deep learning malware classifiers: A systematic experimental study (February 2026)

📦 Packers / After 2010

  • HimitsuShell (⭐68) - A shell script protector that converts shell scripts into binaries with an embedded interpreter, obfuscation, and anti-debug protections (shc alternative).

🔧 Tools / Before 2000

  • XVolkolak (⭐4) - Qt/CMake emulator-unpacker project with a GUI and a console application.

4. Awesome Javascript

MVC Frameworks and Libraries / Runner

  • pion (⭐131) - React Hooks API for standard web components with lit-html.

5. Awesome Go

Advanced Console UIs

  • eyez (⭐1) - eyez is a handy CLI tool that lets you view images directly in your terminal, with support for most terminal emulators.

Networking

  • telepath (⭐3) - telepath is a powerful CLI tool for secure port forwarding with support for multiple jump hosts and flexible authentication.

Security

  • certifier (⭐1) - Library and CLI for generating and validating X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, CRLs, and OCSP responses.

Video

  • onvif-go (⭐40) - ONVIF client, WS-Discovery and virtual camera server for IP cameras.
  • rtspeek (⭐1) - Library and CLI for probing RTSP streams and reporting reachability, latency, codecs, and resolutions.

Code Analysis / Libraries for creating HTTP middlewares

  • gocondense (⭐19) - A gofmt-compatible formatter that condenses multi-line constructs onto single lines where they fit.

6. Awesome Machine Learning

Python / Speech Recognition

  • tiny-audio (⭐169) - Minimal, hackable PyTorch/Hugging Face codebase for training LLM-based speech recognition by connecting a frozen pretrained speech encoder to a pretrained LLM through a small trained projector, with word timestamps, speaker diarization and a free course.

7. Free Programming Books (Japanese)

JavaScript / Vue.js

  • The chibivue Book - ubugeeei

8. Awesome V

Games

  • VCraft (⭐6) - A voxel sandbox game written entirely in V with procedural terrain, biomes, water, mining/building, and a hotbar HUD.

9. Collective Ai Tools

Chatbots

  • Honer AI - Android assistant for AI conversations, writing, translation, and web search with sources, with Russian and English interfaces. #free

Developer Tools

  • ERIUS PHONE - Hosted Android phones that an AI agent controls over an HTTP API or an open-source MCP server to use and test apps: read the screen, tap, type, swipe, install APKs, and pull crash logs. Early access.#paid #testing #opensource
  • VideoGen API - REST API with TypeScript and Python SDKs for creating editable marketing videos from storyboards, scripts and voiceovers, then editing and exporting projects; a VideoGen account and paid generation credits are required. #paid #api

Finance

  • Equibles - US stock market data for ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants through a hosted MCP server and a REST API, covering SEC filings, financial statements, earnings call transcripts, insider and congressional trades and 13F holdings. #freemium #mcp
  • Tapetide - Indian stock market MCP server: research, screen and track about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client. #freemium #mcp #opensource

Image Generator

  • MyPhotoAI - Turn your selfies into AI headshots and portraits. #paid

Productivity

  • Tale - Open-source project workspace where teams assign tasks to AI agents in persistent sandboxes and review their reports and deliverables together. #free #opensource

Search Engine

  • AI Compare - Free editorial AI-tool search and comparison with sourced pricing, limits, and an LLM API cost calculator. #free #research

Social Media

  • Unsora - Generates AI images, video, music and voiceovers and schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and other connected accounts. #paid #opensource

Video

  • DoneCut - Upload raw footage and an AI editor returns a finished YouTube video or Shorts with captions, motion graphics and music. #paid
  • SeedanceCheap - Independent Seedance 2.5 studio for 30-second video requests with free prompt planners, one-time paid packs, an eligibility-limited first trial, and an account-scoped generation API. #paid
  • ScaleReach - Turns long YouTube and other videos into 9:16 short clips with AI captions and face-tracking crop. #paid
  • VideoGen - Creates editable product and marketing videos from storyboards, scripts and voiceovers in a browser editor with captions and exports; paid generation credits are required. #paid #video

Writing

  • Dearovo - AI relationship message writer with context, tone, and length controls. #freemium

10. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • IP99 - IP risk and geolocation API with passive DNS and certificate transparency. Free without a key: 500 IP lookups/day; 10 domain/cert trial lookups/day.

11. Awesome Selfhosted

Software / Analytics

  • Dreeve ⚠ - Statistics dashboard generated from Strava data. (Demo, Source Code (⭐2.1k)) AGPL-3.0 Docker/K8S

Software / Inventory Management

  • CellarBoss - Wine inventory management system. (Source Code (⭐2)) GPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs

Software / Self-hosting Solutions

  • Mother-of-All-Self-Hosting (⭐1.1k) - Ansible playbook which helps you host services as Docker containers on your own server. AGPL-3.0 Ansible/Docker

12. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • pelazas/p2pmux (⭐72) [p2pmux] - Peer-to-peer terminal multiplexer for macOS and Linux where multiple users and machines join the same session; every pane is a real shell on the machine of whoever opened it

Applications / Web Servers

  • ferronweb/ferron (⭐2.2k) - A fast, modern web server built for production debugging.

Development tools / Build system

  • euv-cli (⭐16) [euv-cli] - The official CLI tool for the euv UI framework, providing dev/release profiles with run/build modes, hot reload, and wasm-pack integration.

Development tools / Static analysis

  • MykytaStel/repopilot (⭐24) [repopilot] - Local, deterministic review of Git changes, including AI-agent edits: weakened tests and checks, callers broken by removed APIs, and risky boundary changes; CLI, MCP server and agent hooks

Libraries / Artificial Intelligence

  • Mattbusel/tokio-prompt-orchestrator (⭐59) [tokio-prompt-orchestrator] - Tokio pipeline for serving LLM requests with dedup, circuit breakers, retries, rate limits and a dead-letter queue in front of Anthropic, OpenAI, llama.cpp or vLLM.

13. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • Device Hub Pro (⭐1) - Mirror, control and test Android emulators and phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side.

Design and Product / Screen Recording

  • Caplo (⭐20) - Screen recorder and editor with automatic camera moves, cursor effects, canvas, and captions.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • FreeAudio (⭐2) - Per-app volume and mute, output device switching, and volume control for HDMI/DisplayPort monitors.
  • FreeDisplay (⭐4) - Control external display brightness, HiDPI modes, resolution, and arrangement from the menu bar.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • Boost (⭐16) - Free memory without closing apps, freeze apps and restore them exactly as they were, and find disk space that's genuinely safe to reclaim.

Utilities / Productivity

  • QDuo - Popup at the cursor that runs your own actions on selected text in any app: AI prompts, search, text transforms, Shortcuts, and shell scripts.

Utilities / Finder Tools

  • FinderRight (⭐14) - Open-source Finder extension that adds new file, open in terminal, copy path, and cut & paste to the right-click menu.

14. Awesome Osint

Google Dorks Tools

  • DorkEye (⭐149) - Automated Google dorking tool that generates thousands of advanced queries per second from a file to find exposed files, thanks to CAPTCHA bypass and ban avoidance. It also tests for vulnerabilities, runs multi-agent analysis, and extracts metadata.

Image Analysis / GitHub

  • TrueScreen C2PA Viewer - Free in-browser tool that reads and checks the Content Credentials (C2PA manifest) of a file, with no upload and no account.

Data and Statistics / GitHub

  • NarcoScope - Public-interest explorer of official drug-market prices, precursor flows, seizures, and public-health context, with source links and explicit evidence gaps.

Web Monitoring / GitHub

  • Wayback-Diff (⭐2)

15. Awesome Claude Code

Research & Scientific Inquiry / Data Visualization

  • geo-sleuth (⭐1.6k) by Oldcircle - An agent skill that geolocates a photo with no readable text. Single-purpose Python scripts search and rank candidates using OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view. The answer comes with a camera position, heading, error radius and an evidence image. NOTE: Scripts involve contact with Baidu and Yandex.\       

Providers, Runtime & Integration Infrastructure / Data Visualization

  • Agents Can Communicate (ACC) (⭐129) by Mykola Maksymenko - Local, multi-provider agent communication tool. Adds hooks and a skill to exchange questions and reviews, and saves decisions, verification results and handoffs for later sessions. Each session keeps its own client, model, conversation and permissions.\       
  • Claude Code Local (⭐3.4k) by Matt Macosko - Runs Claude Code fully on-device on Apple Silicon: a native MLX server speaks the Anthropic Messages API, so the unmodified claude CLI works against local Qwen, Gemma and Llama models with no cloud calls. Includes RAM-based model selection, a tool-call parser for local models' output formats, and a verified-offline mode.\       
  • Repowire (⭐265) by Prassanna Ravishankar - A live mesh network that connects Claude Code and other providers so they can talk to each other in real time. Built for emergent coordination. Agents discover each other and share context across project boundaries. Uses tmux sessions as the coordination layer with logical "circles" for peer isolation. Includes a web dashboard and Telegram bot.\       

Status Lines / Data Visualization

  • claude-carbon (⭐211) by Gaëtan Wittebolle - Tracks the carbon footprint of Claude Code sessions, feautring a live CO2 estimate in the status line, computed locally from token usage, next to the session cost.\       

Design & UI/UX / Data Visualization

  • atelier (⭐1) by Ethan Yucetepe - Claude Code plugin with eight design-automation skills driven by one schema-validated brand.json: design tokens for CSS, Tailwind, TypeScript and Figma, social cards, favicon and app-icon sets, responsive AVIF and WebP images, HTML-to-video recording, a WCAG 2.1 AA audit, and a runtime UX audit covering bfcache, INP, dialogs and mobile viewports.\       
  • bdg (Browser Debugger CLI) (⭐152) by szymdzum - A CLI and Claude Code skill for UI debugging in Chrome using the DevTools Protocol, including DOM inspection, browser events, rendered styles, and detailed layout information.\       
  • Pinpoint (⭐3) by gowtham012 - Local MCP server, Claude Code hooks and a Chrome extension for marking up a running app: clicking an element (or one in the iOS Simulator) and typing a change delivers the comment to Claude Code with the selector, DOM path, computed styles, component chain, source-file hint and a cropped screenshot.\       

Writing & Prose Quality / Data Visualization

  • Story Skills (⭐287) by Daniel Dewhurst - Skills for planning and drafting fiction as markdown with YAML frontmatter: story bible, characters, worldbuilding, arcs, scenes, and chapters. Includes a dependency-free CLI whose continuity checker flags characters appearing after their death, payoffs placed before their setup, and stale story state.\       

Infrastructure & DevOps / Data Visualization

  • mirrord (⭐29) by MetalBear - Agent skills and a Claude Code plugin marketplace for mirrord, which runs a local process inside a live Kubernetes cluster's network, environment and traffic. Lets Claude verify changes against real services, databases and queues instead of mocks, with skills for config, CI, database branching, Kafka queue splitting and preview environments.\       

Security / Data Visualization

  • Gryph (⭐173) by SafeDep - Gryph is a security layer for AI coding agents. It hooks into Claude Code and enforces YAML policy rules that block, warn, or guide actions in real time, then logs every event to a local SQLite database for review and audit.\       

Agent Orchestration / Data Visualization

  • Agent 007 (⭐4) by bill10 - A self-hosted office with a pleasing pixel-art UI where one manager agent, Billion, takes a mission, posts jobs to a board, and reviews and merges pull requests that Claude Code and Codex workers open from their own git worktrees. Accessible from desktop or mobile.\       
  • Consort (⭐32) by Kevin Hartman - Spec-first, test-driven agent framework: runs the build loop against live Lakebase Postgres branches under a deterministic orchestrator, with human-approval gates.\       

Agent Orchestration / SDLC

  • Charrette (⭐7) by Stefan Teofanovic - A Claude Code plugin with agent skills for designing software before code is written: brainstorm boards, plans cut into slices and run by subagents, working HTML mockups, development workbenches and layered pull request reviews. Every document renders live in a bundled local viewer with Mermaid diagrams, outside the repository.\       
  • napkin-to-blueprint (⭐6) by Tapas Mukherjee - A five-stage pipeline of Claude Code slash commands and specialized subagents that turns a raw product idea into a build-ready blueprint: an interview-driven brief, researched feature definitions, per-feature specs with acceptance criteria, and an architecture with a database schema.\       
  • OctoShell (⭐4) by savvasioakeim - Terminal workspace for Windows and macOS, built on command blocks, that runs Claude Code in git worktrees, one per task, each with its own shell and dev server. Features include Strategy Mode (several agents plan a change before writing code), a Reviewer agent that reads each change for regressions, and QA Mode (checklist over the running app).\       

Observability & Monitoring / SDLC

  • bough (⭐118) by nickelsec - Reads Claude Code JSONL session transcripts and draws a project's history as a creatively-styled diagram: a day, the tasks inside it, and every prompt, with the ones that ended in a commit marked. Segments work from pauses in the record rather than anything the user labelled, and prompts can be searched by the words they contain.\       

Observability & Monitoring / Session Monitors

  • cc-semaphore (⭐1) by patakuti - A lightweight session monitor for parallel Claude Code sessions. Aggregates running/waiting/idle status across sessions into the OS status bar or system tray, with the same experience on native Linux (GNOME Shell extension) and Windows (system tray via WSL). Also includes a scriptable trigger system for state-transition commands.\       
  • wattop (⭐1) by Jasonm4130 - Terminal monitor for Apple Silicon Macs that shows live Claude Code and Codex sessions, including subagent and workflow trees, with output tokens/s, context fill and estimated cost beside CPU/GPU power, temperatures and fans. Reads local transcripts.\       

Observability & Monitoring / Usage & Cost

  • Codeburn (⭐11k) by iamtoruk - Breakdown of local spend down by project, model, git branch and task. Tracks plan quotas, and identifies token waste, including unused MCP servers, verbose CLAUDE.md, repeated file reads, and more.\       
  • context-tax (⭐1) by Harbor - A zero-dependency CLI (npx context-tax) that reads Claude Code session transcripts to measure what is sent on every turn before the first prompt: system prompt, MCP tool names, the skill listing and instruction files. It prices each item per use, counts skills sent without a description once the listing budget runs out, and context-tax fix points each finding at the setting that turns it off.\

items.summary: 16 awesome list updated on Oct 09, 2026, including Awesome Preact, Awesome Storybook, Awesome Cytodata, Awesome Go, Webcomponents the Right Way, Static Analysis, Magictools, Awesome Langchain, Awesome Graphql, Awesome Game Remakes, Awesome Datascience, Awesome Ai, Free for Dev, Awesome Rust, Awesome Gemini Cli, Awesome Mac

#### [1. Awesome Preact](/content/preactjs/awesome-preact/README.md)

##### Contents / Boilerplates

*   [Extension.js Templates (⭐12)](https://github.com/extension-js/examples) - Preact starters for popup, new tab, content script and devtools pages, ready to run in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari.

##### Contents / Components

*   [@zikojs/preact-console (⭐22)](https://github.com/zikojs/console/tree/main/packages/integrations/preact) - A console-like UI component for Preact that renders JavaScript console output directly inside your application.

#### [2. Awesome Storybook](/content/lauthieb/awesome-storybook/README.md)

##### Community resources

*   [Sherlo](https://sherlo.io) - Visual regression testing for React Native, integrated with Storybook; renders on iOS and Android simulators in the cloud.

##### Examples

*   [Bestax - Storybook](https://bestax.io/storybook/)

#### [3. Awesome Cytodata](/content/cytodata/awesome-cytodata/README.md)

##### 🌟 Purpose

*   **Centralize Knowledge**: Provide a "one-stop shop" for foundational and state-of-the-art research.
*   **Lower Entry Barriers**: Help new researchers navigate "Influential Papers" selected by the community.
*   **Promote Open Science**: Highlight publicly available datasets and open-source pipelines.
*   **Standardize Discovery**: Offer a professional, searchable index for DOIs and software repositories.

##### 🚀 Key Features / 📚 The Literature Corpus

*   **Advanced Search**: Real-time fuzzy searching via [Fuse.js](https://www.fusejs.io/) across titles, authors, journals, and abstracts.
*   **Author Formatting**: Scientific citation style (`Lastname, F. et al.`) for professional scanning.
*   **Filtering**: Sort by year, category (Methods, Biology, Reviews, etc.), or influential status.
*   **Direct Access**: One-click DOI links to publisher pages.

##### 🚀 Key Features / 💾 Dataset Index

*   A curated table of massive public releases like the **Cell Painting Gallery**, **JUMP-CP**, and **RxRx**.
*   Filterable by description and reference paper.

##### 🚀 Key Features / 🛠️ Software Directory

*   Catalog of community-standard tools including **CellProfiler**, **DeepProfiler**, and **PyCytominer**.
*   Categorized by purpose (Feature Extraction, Data Engineering, etc.).

##### 🛠️ Technical Architecture / 🛠️ Software Directory

*   **Frontend**: React 19+ (ESM-based via CDN for zero-install development).
*   **Styling**: Tailwind CSS for a clean, academic aesthetic.
*   **Search Engine**: Fuse.js for client-side fuzzy indexing of JSON data.
*   **Data Layer**: Flat JSON files in `/data/` acting as a "Local Database" for easy community contributions.
*   **Deployment**: Automated GitHub Actions workflow for validation and hosting.

##### 🤝 Contributing / 🛠️ Software Directory

*   Read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cytodata/awesome-cytodata/blob/master/readme.md/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
*   Run `python3 scripts/add_resource.py paper` or `python3 scripts/add_resource.py dataset` to add your entry (or edit the JSON files in `public/data/` by hand).
*   Open a Pull Request.

#### [4. Awesome Go](/content/avelino/awesome-go/README.md)

##### Artificial Intelligence

*   [clai (⭐146)](https://github.com/baalimago/clai) - Agentic harness focused on terminal workflows, following UNIX principles. No external dependencies, ideal for scripting/prototyping agentic apps, engine is also exposed as a package.

##### Job Scheduler

*   [RunWisp (⭐64)](https://github.com/runwisp/runwisp) - Single-binary replacement for cron and supervisord that keeps the exit code and output of every run, with a web UI and a TUI.

#### [5. Webcomponents the Right Way](/content/mateusortiz/webcomponents-the-right-way/README.md)

##### Component Libraries

*   [Accesserty UI Kit (⭐2)](https://github.com/Accesserty/UI-Kit) - HTML-first accessible web components with built-in keyboard behavior, state handling, and i18n. No runtime dependencies.

#### [6. Static Analysis](/content/analysis-tools-dev/static-analysis/README.md)

##### Multiple languages / [Other](#other-1)

*   [Kin](https://kinlab.ai) — A graph-native code repository for people and AI agents. Kin parses supported languages into code entities and their relationships (calls, references, imports, inheritance) and versions them with the source. The kin CLI and an MCP server query the same graph for callers, references, traces and what a change might affect. Imports existing Git history. Public beta.

##### Other / [Other](#other-1)

*   [ember-template-lint (⭐265)](https://github.com/ember-template-lint/ember-template-lint) — Linter for Ember or Handlebars templates.

#### [7. Magictools](/content/ellisonleao/magictools/README.md)

##### Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

*   :free: [AnimGen Free Sprite Sheet Tools](https://animgen.com/tools) - Browser tools that convert GIFs to sprite sheets and back, slice grid sheets or auto-extract sprites from sheets with no grid, export PNG sequences, and remove solid or green-screen GIF backgrounds. Files stay on your device; sheets come with Aseprite-format JSON.

#### [8. Awesome Langchain](/content/kyrolabs/awesome-langchain/README.md)

##### Tools / Templates

*   [Full-Stack AI Agent Template (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/vstorm-co/full-stack-ai-agent-template): FastAPI + Next.js project generator where the agent backend can be LangChain, LangGraph or DeepAgents (or Pydantic AI), with WebSocket streaming, RAG, auth and Docker setup ![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/vstorm-co/full-stack-ai-agent-template?style=social)

#### [9. Awesome Graphql](/content/chentsulin/awesome-graphql/README.md)

##### iOS / React

*   [Baton (⭐13)](https://github.com/shergin/baton) - Relay-style GraphQL client for SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose, with a fragment beside each view and a normalized store the UI observes.

#### [10. Awesome Game Remakes](/content/radek-sprta/awesome-game-remakes/README.md)

##### Action

*   [Earthworm Jim HD Recompiled (⭐44)](https://github.com/TekRantGaming/earthworm-jim-hd-recompiled) - Recomp of Earthworm Jim HD (Xbox 360) to PC.
*   [King Kong Recompiled (⭐105)](https://github.com/TekRantGaming/king-kong-recompiled) - Recomp of King Kong (Xbox 360) to PC.
*   [MDK Sdl (⭐25)](https://github.com/nemo22/mdk-sdl) - Port of MDK (Shiny) to SDL. Includes enhancements.
*   [Simpsons Wrestling Recompiled (⭐17)](https://github.com/TekRantGaming/simpsons-wrestling-recompiled) - Recomp of Simpsons Wrestling (PS1) to PC.
*   [Starfox Recomp (⭐19)](https://github.com/mstan/StarFoxSNESRecomp) - Recomp + enhancement of Starfox (SNES).
*   [Ultimate MK3 iOS (⭐26)](https://github.com/MaryNCRT/Ultimate-Mortal-Kombat-3-iOS-Recomp) - Recomp of Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 iOS to PC.

##### Adventure

*   [Titanic: Adventure Out of Time (⭐9)](https://github.com/itskenny0/titanic-godot) - Recomp of Titanic Adventure Out of Time to Godot.

##### RPG

*   [DQ8 Recompiled (⭐37)](https://github.com/Sinan-Karakaya/DQ8-Recompiled) - Recomp of Dragon's Quest 8 (PS2) to PC.
*   [Earthbound Companion (⭐10)](https://github.com/rages4calm/earthbound-companion) - Recomp of Earthbound (SNES) to PC.
*   [Ultima 5 (⭐8)](https://github.com/synthwave-pixel/ultima5) - Modern engine for Ultima 5.

##### Platformer

*   [Conker's Bad Fur Day Reloaded (⭐60)](https://github.com/DahSidiAbdallah/ConkerBFDReloaded) - Recomp and enhancements for Conker's Bad Fur Day (N64).

##### Racing

*   [Daytona Arcade Recomp (⭐139)](https://github.com/alphanu1/daytona-arcade-recomp) - Recomp of Daytona Racing to PC.
*   [Rollcage Redux](https://www.codemonkey.me.uk/rollcage_redux.php) - Port of the classic game Rollcage.
*   [RVGL](https://rvgl.org/) - Cross-platform engine for Re-Volt.
*   [SpeedBreaker (⭐125)](https://github.com/SpeedBreakerProject/speedbreaker) - Recomp of Need For Speed: Most Wanted (2005, Xbox 360) to PC.

##### Simulator

*   [OpenReliant (⭐18)](https://github.com/OpenReliant/openreliant) - Rebuild of Starlancer in Zig and SDL3.

#### [11. Awesome Datascience](/content/academic/awesome-datascience/README.md)

##### Deep Learning Packages / Visualization Tools

*   [cvdmaps](https://pypi.org/project/cvdmaps/) - Colorblind-safe colormaps and color cycles for matplotlib. matplotlib's default cycle is not colorblind-safe; one call swaps it for an Okabe-Ito palette verified under protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia.

##### Datasets / Book Deals (Affiliated)

*   [Tour Group Headset and Loudspeaker Rules](https://huggingface.co/datasets/first-point/tour-group-headset-rules) - 198 written rules from 36 countries on how guided tour groups may be heard at museums, palaces, archaeological sites and historic city centres (headset requirements, loudspeaker bans), each checked against its official source. CSV and JSONL, CC-BY-4.0.

#### [12. Awesome Ai](/content/abordage/awesome-ai/README.md)

##### AI Coding Agents / General Purpose

*   [Berrry-Computer/vibe-compiler (⭐70)](https://github.com/Berrry-Computer/vibe-compiler) — RAG for integrating GenAI in apps ☆`70`
*   [Berrry-Computer/poorcoder (⭐60)](https://github.com/Berrry-Computer/poorcoder) — DIY Poor Man's AI Coder ☆`60`

#### [13. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md)

##### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [Network Data Labs](https://www.networkdatalabs.com) - An IP geolocation API with accuracy radius and confidence level, ASN, and Tor, known VPN, privacy relay and hosting signals. The free plan includes 1,000 requests per day.

##### Email

*   [disban.io](https://disban.io/) - Protect user signups from disposable emails, or just validate an email against disposable service. Free 2000 check credits per month, No Credit Card required.

##### Remote Desktop Tools

*   [StarDesk](https://www.stardesk.net) - Free remote desktop for work and gaming with 4K HDR/144fps streaming across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.

1. Awesome Preact

Contents / Boilerplates
